title: Systemic osteoprotective effects of Epimedii Folium and Ligustri Lucidi Fructus in senile osteoporosis rats by promoting the osteoblastogenesis and osteoclastogenesis based on MLP-ANN model.
summary: The study reports bone outcomes and osteoblast/osteoclast markers in treated rats, with model analyses linking herbal components to measured effects. Rat-model findings do not establish efficacy or safety in people; the computational component analysis is not causal proof of each component’s mechanism.
ai_technology: An MLP artificial neural network analyzed herb-component relationships alongside animal experiments on Epimedii Folium and Ligustri Lucidi Fructus in senile osteoporosis rats.
